id_convention: Module codes are C0-C14 (the `code` field). The two-digit form (C08) appears only in outcome IDs (C08-O5), critical-skill IDs and exhibit IDs. Theory, regulatory, fraud and document keys are TM-, REG-, FRD- and DOC- IDs from the theory map, the two matrices and the registry; links.py is their single source.

proposed_course_outcomes.text: Classify a loan request as business-purpose or consumer, and name the federal and state rules that govern it.
Build underwritten income, value and sponsor strength from source documents, and reconcile them where they disagree.
Size, price and structure a loan within policy, showing the binding test and the downside case.
Detect fraud, sanctions and compliance red flags, and route each one to the person who may clear it.
Close a loan with a perfected lien, a correct funds flow and a complete collateral file.
Service a loan to repayment, and resolve a default at the lowest net loss.
Recommend a loan at credit committee within authority, policy and portfolio limits.
